$comment: Curated Claude Code permission baseline adapted from the idd-skill v0.11.0 opt-in template (see docs/permissions.md#claude-code-permission-baseline for the rationale, scope, and known flag/path matching gotchas). This repository has explicitly recorded `mergePolicy: fully_autonomous_merge` in .github/idd/config.json, so `Bash(gh pr merge*)` is allowed below and the template's `node scripts/idd-merge-execute.mjs` / `node bin/idd-merge-execute.mjs` deny entries are intentionally omitted -- worker and merge-capable credentials are the same trusted session under that policy. This allow only changes whether Claude Code prompts before `gh pr merge`; it does not by itself satisfy the workflow's own F2/F3 merge gates. `gh api` is deliberately NOT allowlisted here (see the gh-api DELETE-verb trap in the doc); the DELETE-verb deny entries below remain as defense in depth. Personal additions belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which layers on top of this file. Per issue #115 (a future template re-sync should preserve these, not silently revert them): three otherwise-byte-identical-with-upstream entries are downstream-narrowed -- `git diff*` is split into `git diff` + `git diff *` so it no longer prefix-matches `git difftool --extcmd=...`; `git branch -v*` is narrowed to the bare exact `git branch -v` so it no longer prefix-matches `git branch -v -D <name>` (bypassing the `git branch -D*` deny below); and `git fetch origin*` is split into `git fetch origin` + `git fetch origin *` so it no longer prefix-matches a remote name merely starting with `origin` (e.g. `originEvil`), which -- if that remote itself resolves to a local-path or `ext::` transport -- reopens the arbitrary-transport vector this rule exists to close (found via Copilot review on the same PR, verified empirically) -- and one new defense-in-depth deny, `git fetch origin --upload-pack*`, is added below (see docs/permissions.md for its known residual gaps).
